title: Make selection menus easier to distinguish

title: Give empty and unavailable screens useful explanations
deliveredClaim: Database views distinguish initial loading, refresh, true emptiness, no filter matches, denied access and read failure. Failed refreshes retain a marked successful result; denied reads remove it. Related-count failures retain the main record and show Unavailable instead of zero. Generic form retries use the same error/loading cleanup as initial loading.
testPlanClaim: Failed/denied reads, empty filters, retained filters, stale requests and repeated form recovery are exercised in actual mounted components. Database read errors are presented as recovery guidance.
